title: Washer Motor Short Circuit
detail_of_failure: When driving the window washer drive circuit (grounded), a short circuit was sensed when an abnormal current flowed in the circuit.
controller_action: • Stops the output to the window washer motor. • Even if the cause of the failure is removed, the machine does not become normal until the starting switch is turned to the OFF position once.
machine_effect: The window washer does not operate.

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of checking method, see “RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Check that the system operating lamp is turned off. Turn the battery disconnect switch to the OFF position. 3. Remove fuse No.4 in fuse box F01. 4. Check if the fuse is blown. 5. Check the fuse for continuity. 6. Is the fuse normal?

branches.YES: • The fuse is normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The fuse is defective. • It blown, go to “Ground fault in wiring harness”. • If the fuse is not blown but has no continuity, replace the fuse. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect connector M06. 3. Connect the T-adapter to the female side of connector M06. 4. Measure the resistance. 5. steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Check that the system operating lamp is turned off. Turn the battery disconnect switch to the OFF position. 3. Remove fuse No.4 in fuse box F01. 4. Disconnect connector CP01 and connector M06. 5. Connect the T-adapter to the female side of connector CP01. 6. Turn the battery disconnect switch to the ON position. 7. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. 8. Measure the voltage. 9. Does the measurement result agree with the standard value? Stand- Item Measurement position and condition ard value Between CP01 (female) (3) and Max. 1 Voltage ground V

branches.YES: • The wiring harness has no hot short circuits. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The wiring harness has a hot short circuit. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Do the preceding troubleshooting again. 2. Have you identified the cause when the inspection is done again?

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Install all the configuration equipment and connect them. 3. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. 4. Turn the washer switch to the ON position. 5. Is this failure code shown?

branches.YES: Return to the first inspection item.
